notes: Brad Jacobs is a career CEO and the founder of Jacobs Private Equity (his family office). Brad created and grew three platforms using a roll-up strategy that resulted in seven multibillion-dollar publicly traded companies. He and his teams have raised $30 billion of capital, completed 500 acquisitions, created hundreds of thousands of jobs, and generated annual returns to shareholders in excess of 50%. Brad shares his playbook in his aptly named book, How to Make a Few Billion Dollars . In December, he announced a billion-dollar PIPE into a new platform opportunity, of which $900 million is his personal capital. Our conversation is a master class in all aspects of leadership and management, including identifying an opportunity, acquiring businesses, assessing people, managing talent, running operations, leading electric meetings, motivating and compensating team members, and embarking on his next platform investment.  Brad Jacobs – Masterclass on Leadership and Management (EP.368) Feb 12, 2024

 Brad Jacobs is a career CEO and the founder of
Jacobs Private Equity (his family office). Brad created and grew
three platforms using a roll-up strategy that resulted in seven
multibillion-dollar publicly traded companies. He and his teams
have raised $30 billion of capital, completed 500 acquisitions,
created hundreds of thousands of jobs, and generated annual returns
to shareholders in excess of 50%. Brad shares his playbook in his
aptly named book,  How to Make a Few Billion Dollars .
In December, he announced a billion-dollar PIPE into a new platform
opportunity, of which $900 million is his personal capital.

Our conversation is a master class in all aspects of leadership and
management, including identifying an opportunity, acquiring
businesses, assessing people, managing talent, running operations,
leading electric meetings, motivating and compensating team
members, and embarking on his next platform investment.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
